Name: Anette's Clover Grass for Grass Variety 1.6
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center][size=6]All assets thanks to the lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/dugongkebalik?gameId=1303]Dugong[/url][/size][/center]
[center][b][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15033]Anette's Clover Grass Original[/url][/color][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download, unzip, put it in your mods folder. Make sure you're not running MoreGrass, only GrassVariety. And remove the original Clover Grass if you still have it. [/color][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/center]
[center]Converts Anette's Clover Grass into a Grass Variety pack. Made for Stardew 1.6. If you want to see more clovers and less other grass, change the weight setting in the MCM.[/center]
